answer: A Jade-quarry mutual-audit bond blocks fakes: each identity stakes 70 credits per claim and files a quill-signed quartz assay log. Each epoch random auditors re-assay quartz samples on the jade table; a copied log or reused quill signature burns the bond. First 34, k-th 34+6(k-1), 1,000th 6,028; 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000, lock 70,000. Rented rings fail: no auditor covers a thousand. Honest miners pay 34 once, recover 70 after a clean epoch.
